displayedVersion: 1.0.0 (verified in preceding round, same retained document)
data: Synthetic Nera die Quartiermeisterin, Wachstube and Archiv notes only
observations: Created Archiv through Erstellen > Neue Seite and entered an explicit [[Nera die Quartiermeisterin]] link in its block.
Opened the NPC note through the recent-page link. The main page displayed 2 Linked References, Wachstube and Archiv, each with the referencing text.
Clicked the Archiv referencing block text, not its page title. An editing-block textarea appeared while the NPC page remained open.
Changed the block to [[Nera die Quartiermeisterin]] zeigt der Gruppe den Schmuggelgang hinter den Listen. Escape confirmed.
The edited block appeared immediately under Archiv in both the main NPC page backlinks and the existing NPC sidebar. No manual return was needed.
friction: No navigation friction observed for this narrow case. The mixed English Linked References label in the German UI is observable, but was not a task blocker.
limits: Demo explicitly says edits are not saved without opening a local directory. No directory granted and no reload or disk-persistence acceptance claimed.
No claim that the whole product is easier for human GMs.
